caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents two vertically stacked line plots comparing the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B under two methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on Easy and Hard training sets, respectively. Both plots share the same x-axis labeled “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 100, and the same y-axis labeled “Training Rewards,” ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, both with linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot (“Easy Training Set”), the teal line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” begins near 0.0, rises steadily to approximately 0.35 at step 500, and is accompanied by a shaded confidence region. The red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” also starts near 0.0, increases more steeply, and reaches approximately 0.4 at step 500, also with a shaded confidence region. In the bottom plot (“Hard Training Set”), the teal line “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” begins near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.05 by step 100, then declines toward 0.0 after step 150, with a narrow shaded region. The red line “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” starts near 0.0, increases gradually with fluctuations, and reaches approximately 0.2 at step 500, also with a shaded confidence region. Both plots use solid lines with no markers and include gridlines for reference.
